name: Uhlaselo lwe-asthma
sources: Inkqubo yeSizwe yeMfundo yeMbefu yoMzantsi Afrika

urgent.heading: Ingxamisekile — tsalela umnxeba ngoku
urgent.primary_message: Sebenzisa impompo yokuphefumla (i-inhaler) eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka yokukhulula ukuphefumla. Ukuba akukho phucuko kwimizuzu eli-10 — Tsalela umnxeba ku-10177.
red_flags: Uphelelwa ngumoya kakhulu kangangokuba akakwazi ukuthetha izivakalisi ezipheleleyo
Imilebe, iinzipho okanye ubuso bujika luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka okanye bungwevu
Isifuba sitsalela ngaphakathi phakathi kweembambo ngomphefumlo ngamnye
Ipompi yokukhulula ayincedi okanye iyaphela ngaphantsi kweeyure ezi-4
Ukozela, ukudideka okanye ukudinwa ngenxa yomzamo wokuphefumla
Isifuba esithe cwaka — ukuvutha kuyayeka kuba umoya ungenelela kancinci kakhulu ukuze kuvakale isandi

what_is_it.heading: Uhlaselo lwe-asthma ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: Uhlaselo lwe-asthma lwenzeka xa iindlela zomoya emiphungeni ziqina ngesiquphe, zidumbe, zize zigcwale umchamo-moya — nto leyo eyenza kube nzima ukungenisa nokukhupha umoya.
paragraphs: Uninzi lohlaselo lwe-asthma lunento eluvusayo — intsholongwane, umsi, ipollen, uthuli, umoya obandayo, umthambo okanye uxinzelelo lweemvakalelo. Izihlunu zeendlela zomoya ziyazibamba, umaleko wangaphakathi uyadumba, kuthi nomchamo-moya uvale indlela eseleyo.

Ipompi yokukhulula (idla ngokuba luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka) ikhulula izihlunu zeendlela zomoya ngemizuzu. Ukuba ayisebenzi, okanye uhlaselo luza rhoqo, umntu udinga uncedo olungxamisekileyo — uhlaselo olunzima lunokubulala.

items.headline: 1 kwabali-10
items.body: Malunga nomntwana omnye kwabali-10 eMzantsi Afrika une-asthma. Abantu abadala abaninzi banayo bengazi.

items.headline: Isabulala
items.body: Amakhulu abantu baseMzantsi Afrika basweleka yi-asthma minyaka le — uninzi lwezi kufa lunokuthintelwa ngonyango olufanelekileyo.

items.headline: Iipompi ezimbini
items.body: Ipompi eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka yokukhulula (isetyenziswa ngexesha lohlaselo) kunye nepompi emdaka yokuthintela (isetyenziswa yonke imihla) — eyokuthintela yiyo ekugcina ungabi sengxakini.

items.headline: Phila ngokupheleleyo
items.body: I-asthma elawulwa kakuhle akufanele ikuthintele emidlalweni, esikolweni, emsebenzini okanye ekulaleni. Ukuba iyakuthintela — unyango lwakho kufuneka luhlengahlengiswe.

pull_quote.text: Ukuba ufikelela kwipompi yakho yokukhulula ngaphezu kwamaxesha amabini ngeveki, i-asthma yakho ayilawulwa kakuhle. Bona ugqirha — musa ukuqhubeka nje usebenzisa eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka.

signs.heading: Uhlaselo lubonakala njani
signs.lede: Uhlaselo lwe-asthma ludla ngokwakheka ngeeyure, ngamanye amaxesha ngeentsuku. Okukhona ulunyanga kwangoko, kokukhona kulula ukulumisa.

items.title: Ukuvutha kwesifuba
items.description: Isandi esinjengokukhalaza xa ukhupha umoya, ngamanye amaxesha nasekungeniseni umoya. Isifuba esithe cwaka kuhlaselo olunzima sithetha ukuba ukuhamba komoya kwehle kakhulu ngendlela eyingozi.

items.title: Ukuphelelwa ngumoya
items.description: Ukutsala nzima ukufumana umoya opheleleyo. Akakwazi ukugqiba isivakalisi ngaphandle kokuma. Isifuba sivakala siqinile.

items.title: Ukukhohlela okungayekiyo
items.description: Ukukhohlela okomileyo nokungapheliyo, rhoqo kubi ebusuku okanye ekuseni kakhulu. Ngamanye amaxesha lolona phawu lodwa ebantwaneni.

items.title: Indlela umzimba omi ngayo
items.description: Ugobile phambili, amagxa aphakamile, iimbambo zitsalela ngaphakathi ngomphefumlo ngamnye, ukuphefumla ngokukhawuleza, ukudinwa.

items.fact: Abanye bayayishiya, abaninzi abayishiyi. Nokuba iimpawu ziyathamba, ubuthathaka beendlela zomoya bunokubuya nakweyiphi na iminyaka. Qhubeka nepompi yokuthintela njengoko imiselwe.
Ii-steroid eziphefumlelwayo kwipompi emdaka yokuthintela zidosi ephantsi kakhulu kwaye zisebenza ikakhulu emiphungeni. Zikhuseleke kakhulu kunee-steroid ezisetyenziswa ngomlomo xa uhlaselo selubi.

items.myth: Ukuba uyakwazi ukuthetha, uhlaselo alukho nzima.
items.fact: Ukuba ukuthetha kulinganiselwe kumabinzana amafutshane — okanye amagama ambalwa — luphawu lwengozi. Isifuba esithe cwaka sibi ngakumbi, asikho ngcono.

items.myth: Amayeza e-asthma afuneka kuphela xa uziva uneempawu.
items.fact: Ipompi yokuthintela (emdaka) kufuneka isetyenziswe yonke imihla, nokuba uziva ulungile. Ilawula ukudumba okuphantsi okubangela uhlaselo.

items.title: Hlala uthe nkqo. Khulula iimpahla eziqinileyo
items.description: Musa ukulala phantsi. Ukuhlala uphakamile iingalo zixhaswe kwenza ukuphefumla kube lula. Zola — uloyiko lwenza ukuphefumla kube mandundu.

items.title: Sebenzisa ipompi eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka — trekha kube kanye
items.description: Sebenzisa ispasiyedi ukuba unayo. Linda imizuzwana engama-30 ukuya kwengama-60. Phinda ukuya kutsho kwiitrekhi ezili-10 zizonke kwimizuzu yokuqala eli-10.

items.title: Ukuba akukho phucuko kwimizuzu eli-10 — Tsalela umnxeba ku-10177
items.description: Yithi 'uhlaselo olunzima lwe-asthma'. Qhubeka usebenzisa ipompi yokukhulula emva kwemizuzu embalwa de kufike abeparamedic.

items.title: Ukuba uyawa okanye ujika luhlaza — Tsalela umnxeba ngoko nangoko
items.description: Musa ukulinda imizuzu eli-10. Uhlaselo olunzima lunokuba yingozi ebomini ngokukhawuleza.

items.title: Emva kohlaselo — bona ugqirha
items.description: Naluphi na uhlaselo oludingise ngaphezu kwedosi eqhelekileyo yepompi yokukhulula luphawu lokuba isicwangciso sakho se-asthma sidinga ukulungiswa. Musa ukutsiba ulandelelo.

get_help.heading: Ngubani omawumfowunele
get_help.lede: Ukuba ipompi eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ayisebenzi okanye uhlaselo luyanda, fumana uncedo. I-asthma iyanyangeka.
